name: Bitrig
long_description: Made by co-creators of SwiftUI, Bitrig is an AI development environment for Apple platforms. It works with real Xcode projects, features built-in simulators, and automates the App Store Connect busy work. You can add in-app purchase and publish to the App Store with just a prompt. Bring your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription.
one_liner: Build and ship native Swift apps with AI

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Kyle is the co-founder and CEO of Bitrig.

Before Bitrig, Kyle spent over a decade at Apple where he co-created and led the development of SwiftUI. He also managed teams behind Swift Charts, WidgetKit, and the Swift Standard Library. Kyle holds a degree in Computer Science from Stanford University.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Co-founder at Bitrig.

Previously SwiftUI at Apple, Square, co-founder at Storehouse (acquired by Square).

BFA Design, University of Washington.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Jacob is a co-founder of bitrig.

Before bitrig, Jacob spent 15 years at Apple, where he co-created and led the development of SwiftUI. He also contributed to Xcode and UIKit during his time there. Prior to Apple, Jacob built Opacity, a graphical design tool.

launches.title: Bitrig – Vibe code, test, and deploy Swift apps. All from your iPhone.
launches.body:
Hi! We’re [Kyle](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kylemacomber/), [Jacob](https://x.com/jacobx), and [Tim](https://www.linkedin.com/in/timdonnelly/), the co-founders of [Bitrig](https://www.bitrig.app).

Bitrig is the only vibe coder that writes native Swift, which is how the top mobile apps are coded. It’s like Lovable for iPhone apps.

[Download](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bitrig/id6747835910) on the App Store today!

https://youtu.be/e-DqSVEI50w

We’re longtime Apple veterans:

* Kyle and Jacob are co-creators of SwiftUI, the framework Apple says is the “the best way to build an app,” and led its development for the past 10 years.
* Tim was a co-founder and designer of Storehouse, where he won an Apple Design Award and was later acquired by Square. At Apple he rewrote the fluid animation system that powers the experience of 1.5 billion iOS users worldwide.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93186&key=user_uploads/547131/634b45de-4ef4-471c-9437-e0dd42eb28d9)

Bitrig lets you build native apps for your phone, on your phone. Just by chatting with AI.

If you’re a designer or PM, Bitrig lets you use the same technology as the developers on your team. If you’re a student, Bitrig is the easiest possible way to get started with Swift.

It’s fast, it’s fun. You can make a change to your app anytime and anywhere inspiration strikes. And it’s as easy to share your creation as airdropping a photo.

Bitrig is a one-stop shop. Vibe code, test, and deploy Swift apps. No Xcode required.

[Download](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bitrig/id6747835910) on the App Store today!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93186&key=user_uploads/547131/6c49fb4f-5e57-4a04-b226-b57a869b9389)

_Behind the scenes: To make Bitrig possible we wrote a custom Swift interpreter. Kind of a crazy thing to do. But the best mobile apps use the native SDK directly, and we wanted to make that level of quality as accessible as possible._
